tasks.subject: Task 1: Distinguish an absent exp from exp: 0
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make expiry detection unambiguous before anything depends on it. Closes #57.

**Files:**
- Modify: addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/Jwt.fs
- Modify: addons/FoundryKit/auth/AuthSession.fs
- Modify: test_project/tests/auth-jwt.test.fs, test_project/tests/auth-session.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A token with no exp claim is distinguishable from one with exp: 0
- is_expired_at treats a present exp: 0 as expired at any time
- A token with no exp is still never-expiring (backend is the authority)
- Opaque tokens behave as no-expiry, unchanged
- Every pre-existing JwtTests and AuthSessionTests case passes unchanged

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/Jwt.fs", "addons/FoundryKit/auth/AuthSession.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["absent exp distinguishable from exp: 0", "present exp: 0 is expired", "pre-existing cases unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: HttpClient - generic async transport
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An awaitable HTTP call returning HttpOutcome, injectable so no test needs a network.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/core/HttpTransport.fs, addons/FoundryKit/core/HttpClient.fs
- Create: test_project/tests/support/fake_http_client.notest.fs, test_project/tests/http-client.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- async send(method, url, headers, body, timeout) -> HttpOutcome
- Backed by trait_name HttpTransport (the seam every later test uses)
- No SceneTree does not hang forever
- Instance stays alive across its own await (mirror NativeRequest's _in_flight registry)
- core/ still references no subsystem

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib && task test:scripts


tasks.subject: Task 5: BackendClient - auth semantics over the transport
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The one place that knows a bearer token goes in a header and a 401 means the session is gone.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/BackendClient.fs
- Create: test_project/tests/auth-backend-client.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Injects Authorization: Bearer only when a non-empty token is supplied
- Answered(2xx) -> ResponseResult.Success
- Answered(401) -> AuthResponse with session_expired=true, NOT an error
- Other non-2xx -> AuthError.RequestFailed(status, body)
- TransportFailed -> RequestFailed(0, detail); TimedOut -> AuthError.TimedOut
- NEVER logs the token, not even truncated
- Exhaustive match, no _ wildcard

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib && task test:scripts

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/BackendClient.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib && task test:scripts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["401 yields Success with session_expired, not Failure", "no header when token empty", "token never logged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: SessionStore - session authority and single-flight refresh
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Hold the active session and guarantee concurrent refreshes collapse into one.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/SessionStore.fs
- Create: test_project/tests/auth-session-store.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- At most one active session; has_session/access_token/set_session/clear
- refresh() is SINGLE-FLIGHT: N concurrent callers cause exactly ONE backend call, asserted by call count
- A failed refresh clears the in-flight marker so a later refresh is attempted
- A successful refresh replaces the session and reports rotation
- No refresh token fails fast with SessionExpired, no backend call
- No shared mutable static state

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/SessionStore.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["three concurrent refreshes make one backend call", "failed refresh does not wedge the store", "no static mutable state"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Wire AuthSubsystem
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Replace the four Configuration stubs with the real thing, and emit the two unsolicited signals.

**Files:**
- Modify: addons/FoundryKit/auth/AuthSubsystem.fs
- Modify: test_project/tests/auth-subsystem.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- _exchange posts the credential and returns SessionResult.Success
- valid_access_token returns current when valid, refreshes when expired, fails SessionExpired otherwise
- refresh_session delegates to SessionStore
- request() injects the token; on 401 refreshes and retries EXACTLY ONCE (asserted by send_count)
- tokens_refreshed and session_expired fire appropriately
- With no BackendConfig, every path still reports Configuration exactly as today
- The class doc comment is rewritten
- An injection seam exists: AuthSubsystem._init takes optional transport and config, matching AppleAuthBackend.new(log, native_override)

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib && task test:scripts && task lint

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/AuthSubsystem.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib && task test:scripts && task lint", "acceptanceCriteria": ["401 retries exactly once, proven by call count", "second 401 is SessionExpired not a loop", "unconfigured path unchanged", "transport injection seam exists"]}
```
